current.text: Harden is back with Cleveland for a full season. He is in the projected starting lineup with Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen.

In Cleveland his usage, shot attempts and free throw attempts are lower. He plays more as a distributor next to Mitchell, Mobley and Watson. With Cleveland he scored under 20 points a game and his field goal percentage became a problem.
Over his last six games in Cleveland he played about 33 minutes with a usage rate of about 24 to 25, and his assists and FG% dropped.
Experts do not expect his usage to recover. They doubt he repeats last season or plays 35 minutes a night again. Josh thinks his end-of-career decline is starting.
Cleveland's bench lost Schroder, Ellis and Strus and has no clear backup point guard.
Harden and Mitchell may stagger their minutes. How much they share the floor is an open question.
He is no longer a first or second round player. The experts' fair range in category leagues is about picks 28 to 40, or the end of round three in 12 teams. Pick 35 feels about right.
Auction value is in the low to mid 20s USD. He went for 24 USD in an expert mock auction.
He is worth less in points leagues (picks 35 to 50, or the 40s) than in category leagues. His Yahoo rank is fine for categories but too high for points.
With a March 28 end, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and then 2 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. Finals week, starting March 22, is a two-game week.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.
His Yahoo status is questionable with an ankle injury.
Cleveland is projected to win about 51 to 53 games.

durable.text: He is still an elite source of assists, and assists are the core of his value.
He is a strong FT% shooter on volume and a heavy turnover source. His FG% is weak for a guard.
He gets to the free throw line less than he used to, his shooting has declined, and he adds little in steals and blocks.
He is 37 years old and is considered durable.

note: Our league paid 42 USD for him last season. This year Yahoo and ESPN value him at 27 to 28 USD (Yahoo average cost 23.8 USD), and the experts put him in the low to mid 20s USD, so do not go far past 25 USD. He fits punt FG% and punt TO builds best, since he gives elite assists and strong FT% on volume with weak FG% and heavy turnovers. Early in the season, check his ankle, whether his minutes stay near 33 and his usage near 24 to 25, and how he shares the floor with Mitchell. His two-game finals week also lowers his value late in the season.
